headlines.title_en: Industry expects RRR cut and rate cut within the year
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data July 31: Dong Ximiao, Chief Economist at China Lianhe and Executive Director of Shanghai Finance and Development Lab, expects RRR and rate cuts in Q3. On rates, if H2 economic recovery momentum weakens, a 10-20bp policy rate cut is possible; but constrained by bank NIMs at ~1.40%, LPR has limited room to fall, likely 5-10bp. On RRR, to support fiscal bond issuance and maintain ample liquidity, there is still 25-50bp of RRR cut room this year, likely timed during bond supply peaks or tight liquidity. The PBOC will also use more structural monetary policy tools to fine-tune liquidity.

headlines.title: 中证报：增韧性强信心，资本市场着力深化投融资综合改革
headlines.summary: 7月30日召开的中共中央政治局会议强调，深化资本市场投融资综合改革，提升资本市场韧性和信心。当日，多位业内人士表示，这一部署为下阶段资本市场高质量发展指明了方向。未来应聚焦资产端提质、资金端引流、政策端优化主线，加快构建“制度可预期、风险可管控、回报可持续”的高质量发展新格局。长期看，随着投融资两端协同发力、全链条监管提质、长钱入市体系持续完善，资本市场有望形成上市公司提质、机构长期布局、市场稳健运行的正向循环，为科技创新、产业升级提供坚实资本支撑。

headlines.title_en: Securities Times: Boosting resilience and confidence, capital markets deepen comprehensive investment and financing reforms
headlines.summary_en: The July 30 Politburo meeting stressed deepening comprehensive capital market investment and financing reforms to enhance resilience and confidence. Industry insiders said this sets direction for high-quality development. Focus should be on improving asset quality, channeling funds, and optimizing policies to build a 'predictable, controllable, sustainable' new structure. Long term, with coordinated supply-demand efforts, improved full-chain regulation, and better long-term capital entry, the market can form a virtuous cycle of better listed firms, long-term institutional positions, and stable operations, supporting tech innovation and industrial upgrades.

headlines.title: 库克称苹果Q2在中国大陆等新兴市场和部分发达市场打破纪录，公司股价盘后跌幅仍然扩大至5%
headlines.summary: 苹果公司CEO库克表示，尽管面临供应链限制和汇率逆风，苹果依然取得了响应的业绩。 尽管面临逆风，6月当季仍创下纪录。他正在大力推介公司的最新产品。他表示，苹果“全面”表现强劲，在印度、中国大陆、日本和东南亚均创下历史新高。同时，在部分发达市场和新兴市场也打破了纪录。 库克正在谈论Siri AI，表示开发者和公众测试版的反馈非常强烈。他表示收到的评价“极为出色”，这些成果“印证”了公司的AI战略。 库克引用IDC数据称，iPhone在当季市场份额有所提升。 苹果美股盘后跌幅扩大至5%。

headlines.title_en: Cook says Apple broke records in mainland China and other emerging markets and some developed markets in Q2, but after-hours stock decline still widens to 5%
headlines.summary_en: Apple CEO Cook says despite supply constraints and FX headwinds, Apple achieved solid results, setting records in the June quarter. He is heavily promoting new products, saying Apple 'comprehensively' strong, with records in India, mainland China, Japan and SE Asia, also in some developed and emerging markets. Cook discusses Siri AI, saying developer and public beta feedback is very strong, with 'excellent' reviews confirming Apple's AI strategy. Cook cites IDC data showing iPhone market share rose in the quarter. Apple stock falls 5% after hours.

headlines.title: 中金：美国经济尚未出现明显放缓 需求仍然稳健
headlines.summary: 中金指出，美国二季度GDP年化环比增长1.5%，虽低于市场预期，但数据并不疲弱。进口、库存和政府支出拖累了GDP，而反映内需的私人国内最终销售环比折年增长3.9%，创2023年初以来最快，显示经济韧性依然较强。消费明显回暖，AI带动的企业投资继续保持高增，住宅投资也开始改善，经济增长动力正逐步由财政刺激转向私人部门。

headlines.title_en: CICC: US economy has not yet shown significant slowdown, demand remains solid
headlines.summary_en: CICC says US Q2 GDP grew 1.5% annualized QoQ, below expectations but not weak. Imports, inventories and government spending dragged, but private domestic final sales grew 3.9% annualized, fastest since early 2023, showing strong resilience. Consumption rebounded, AI-driven capex stayed high, residential investment improved. Growth momentum is shifting from fiscal stimulus to private sector.

headlines.title_en: MIIT: Promote innovative applications of next-generation power batteries, automotive-grade chips, and vehicle operating systems
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology issues 15th Five-Year Plan for Industrial Green and Low-Carbon Development, calling for consolidating green industries. Accelerate tech iteration and scenario expansion for EVs, new energy equipment, new energy storage. Promote next-gen power batteries, automotive chips, vehicle OS applications. Deploy heavy-duty EVs for trunk, short-haul, urban logistics, mining, ports. Boost green electricity use in polysilicon production. Break through high-reliability wind turbine design for desert, high-altitude, deep-sea scenarios. Promote wind-solar-storage integration. Develop large-capacity, high-safety, all-weather, long-life lithium batteries. Expand high-performance lithium battery use in low-altitude equipment, intelligent robots, electric ships, construction machinery, agricultural machinery. Expand new energy storage in power.
